Axiom:
Introducing a NEW `vi.mock(...)` or `vi.hoisted(...)` call in a test file is a gated action. Execution-agent MUST stop before introducing such a mock and request explicit operator confirmation in chat, presenting: - module being mocked, - why dependency injection cannot be used here (per inherited `AX_MOCK_AS_LAST_RESORT`), - what observable contract the mock preserves.
Re-using an existing project-level mock helper does NOT require a new confirmation. `vi.mock` is the single biggest lever for fabricating green tests; confirm-gate makes that fabrication visible.
